import { api, ApiError } from "/src/api/client.js";
export const TEACHER_DENIED_ROUTE = "/teacher-v3/denied";
export function redirectTeacherDenied() {
  if (typeof location !== "undefined" && location.pathname === TEACHER_DENIED_ROUTE) return;
  import("/src/router/index.js").then(({ router }) => {
    router.push(TEACHER_DENIED_ROUTE).catch(() => {
    });
  }).catch(() => {
    location.href = TEACHER_DENIED_ROUTE;
  });
}
export function teacherRequest(method, path, opts = {}) {
  return api.raw(method, path, {
    body: opts.body,
    query: opts.query,
    headers: opts.headers,
    signal: opts.signal,
    idempotencyKey: opts.idempotencyKey
  }).catch((e) => {
    if (e instanceof ApiError && e.code === 40301) redirectTeacherDenied();
    throw e;
  });
}
export function teacherGet(path, query, signal) {
  return teacherRequest("GET", path, { query, signal });
}
export function teacherPost(path, body, idempotencyKey, signal) {
  return teacherRequest("POST", path, { body, idempotencyKey, signal });
}
export function teacherPut(path, body, signal) {
  return teacherRequest("PUT", path, { body, signal });
}
